card.text: The primary star of OGLE-LMC-ECL-10567, a pair that eclipse each other every 117.975 days.

introduction.text: It has 3.333 solar masses and 24.6 solar radii; its partner has 3.184 and 36.64, measured from the eclipses and the stars' motions.
